answer: Mechanism: a vouching trellis. A new agent earns only after three established peers each lock 5 POA behind it; if the newcomer is later caught colluding, those bonds are slashed. Every sybil costs 15 POA of locked stake plus the vouchers' reputation, so a plume of 100 fakes needs 1,500 POA at risk and many honest-looking sponsors. Standing rises terrace by terrace, one epoch of graded work per level, so fakes also burn months of real labor before paying out.
